data.title: CL gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Sep 24, 2023

## [Shipping times are inaccurate](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/650f7201e74693565bdc5e2b)
I ordered a pillow a week ago and have still not received it yet even though the shipping time said 3-5 days. No update since the confirmation of purchase email. After reading the rest of the reviews on here, I realize I’m not alone and many people have ordered things even weeks ago that they didn’t get yet. Should’ve checked the reviews before ordering!

September 16, 2023

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 26, 2023

Hi Carly,

Thank you for reaching out. We deeply apologize for the delay with your item. We are currently backed up with some orders but our team is working diligently to get these orders shipped out as soon as possible. Looking into this further, we see your pillow will arrive this Friday. We appreciate your patience and again, are truly sorry for any inconvenience this has caused.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
